title: Texas Skydiving
specs: Located between Austin and College Station in scenic countryside
Must be at least 18 years old with valid government-issued photo ID
Weight limit 250 lbs fully clothed; $30 fee for over 220 lbs; height/weight proportionate
Good health and reasonable physical fitness required; consult doctor if health concerns
AFF students must have done at least one tandem jump at Texas Skydiving within previous six months
Groups of 6 to 9 get $20 off per jumper; groups of 10 or more get $30 off per jumper
includes: All gear rental, training, lift tickets and packing fees included in AFF pricing
Tandem jump includes instructor and training
gap: Exact duration of AFF full program not stated
blurb: Guests can do tandem skydives or enroll in the Accelerated Freefall (AFF) program to earn skydiving licenses. Tandem jumps include training and a jump with an instructor. AFF includes a day-long first jump course and subsequent coach jumps to progress toward an A License.
extraNote: $100 non-refundable deposit per person required for reservations · Weather delays or cancellations require rescheduling; safety is priority · Tipping is appreciated but not expected · Texas Skydiving drop zone at 1055 Private Road 7022, Lexington, TX 78947 · Year round, weather permitting
